userMessage:
Sprac tento úryvok z kázne do biblickej prezentácie, preklad SEVP. Kazateľ použil skrátený názov knihy v zátvorke bold:

##Žid.## 4:13 A nieto tvora skrytého pred Ním, všetko je obnažené a odkryté očiam Toho, ktorému sa budeme zodpovedať.

setup.description: Compound difficulty: the bold-wrapped reference token is an ABBREVIATION with a trailing period ('##Žid.##', not the full book name) that must resolve via style_guide.md's Slovak book abbreviation table (Žid -> Židom) AND have its ## wrapper fully stripped before it becomes the `book` field on the verse item. main_reference is server-built by state/slides/compose.rs::group_reference as `"{book} {chapter}:{verses} ({translation})"` — if any stray '#' survives in the `book` value the model supplies (e.g. it strips only one of the two markers, or keeps the trailing period as part of a mis-tokenized 'Žid.#'), the composed main_reference itself will contain '##' or '#' and rule 3 (checked BEFORE rule 1's regex) fires on main_reference rather than main.

expected.notes: Targets UnprocessedBoldMarkers via the main_reference path (main_reference.contains("##")) — the harder-to-hit sibling of adv-03, since main_reference is never directly written by the LLM; it only leaks a stray '#' through the `book` argument it supplies. Correct resolution: book = 'Židom' (abbreviation resolved AND markers fully stripped), producing main_reference = 'Židom 4:13 (SEVP)' with zero '#' characters anywhere.
